cues.zh: 译者：Araminta Dutta 审校：Queenie Lee
cues.en: Translator: Araminta Dutta Reviewer: Queenie Lee

cues.zh: 去年，一名黑客一天之内录下了40多通
cues.en: Last year, a hacker recorded over 40 calls

cues.zh: 打给特勤局和FBI的电话，
cues.en: to the Secret Service and the FBI in one day,

cues.zh: 而且无人察觉。
cues.en: without anyone finding out.

cues.zh: 我想在座大多数人都会同意，那是个糟糕的主意。
cues.en: I think most people in here would agree that that was a bad idea.

cues.zh: 推特和新闻上人们都在议论这件事，
cues.en: People on Twitter and the news talked about it,

cues.zh: 有人甚至指控他是个冒牌政府特工。
cues.en: and some people even accused him of being a fraud of a government agent.

cues.zh: 有人骂他是白痴。
cues.en: Some people called him a moron.

cues.zh: 我朋友叫我Bryan。
cues.en: My friends call me Bryan.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 重点不在于那个耸动的标题，
cues.en: The point is not that sensational headline,

cues.zh: 虽然它确实挺耸动的。
cues.en: albeit it is kind of sensational.

cues.zh: 重点是我为什么这么做，以及我为什么站在这里。
cues.en: It's why I did what I did and for why I'm here.

cues.zh: 窃听特勤局可以既简单又有趣。
cues.en: Wiretapping the Secret Service can be easy and fun.

cues.zh: 如果你还没看出来这是讽刺，
cues.en: If you haven't figured out that that is satire,

cues.zh: 那我们就得好好聊聊了。
cues.en: then we need to have a whole other discussion.

cues.zh: 这是Valleywag的头版文章。
cues.en: This was the front-page article on Valleywag.

cues.zh: 这事上了KOMO电视台和很多其他地方。
cues.en: It made it to KOMO and a variety of different places.

cues.zh: 所有这些之所以被翻出来
cues.en: The reason all of this came up

cues.zh: 都是因为这个。
cues.en: was because of this.

cues.zh: 你右边看到的
cues.en: What you see on the right

cues.zh: 是一次常见的本地商家地图搜索——
cues.en: is a common map search for a local business -

cues.zh: 汽车玻璃维修这一类。
cues.en: an auto-glass repair category.

cues.zh: 左边——同样的搜索、同样的橙县城市——
cues.en: On the left - same search, same city in Orange County -

cues.zh: 汽车玻璃维修。
cues.en: auto-glass repair.

cues.zh: 这些列表里有虚假商家，
cues.en: There are fake businesses in these listings,

cues.zh: 看起来和真的没两样。
cues.en: and they look just like the real ones.

cues.zh: 这个房间里恐怕没人
cues.en: There isn't a person in this room

cues.zh: 能凭经验猜出
cues.en: who'd probably be able to make an educated guess

cues.zh: 哪个是哪个。
cues.en: as to which one is which.

cues.zh: 左边的Google列表里有六家假商家，
cues.en: On the left, there are six fake businesses in the Google listings,

cues.zh: 而Whitepages上，有人在乎吗……？
cues.en: and on Whitepages, anyone care ...?

cues.zh: 十家全是假的——十家全假。
cues.en: Ten out of ten - they're all fake.

cues.zh: 它们都由同一个人控制。
cues.en: They're all controlled by one person.

cues.zh: 这个人找到了操控各类本地商家系统的办法，
cues.en: This one person found a way to manipulate the variety of local business systems,

cues.zh: 比如Yelp、Angie's List、Bing，尤其是Google Maps，
cues.en: like Yelp, and Angie's List, and Bing, and especially Google Maps,

cues.zh: 那才是目标。
cues.en: which is the target.

cues.zh: 他们流量最大，带来的生意也最多——
cues.en: They have the most traffic, they generate the most business -

cues.zh: 你要是上了 Google，就稳了。
cues.en: if you're on Google, you're set.

cues.zh: 那会发生什么？
cues.en: So what happens?

cues.zh: 他们挤掉了原来的十个占位商家，
cues.en: They bumped off the original ten placeholders,

cues.zh: 那些人再也接不到本该属于他们的电话了。
cues.en: and they no longer get the phone calls they rightly deserve.

cues.zh: 这就是个骗局。
cues.en: This is a scam.

cues.zh: 从黄页时代起，这种事就一直存在。
cues.en: This has been going on since directories even started.

cues.zh: 互联网之前，黄页里真有人
cues.en: Before the internet, there were actually people in Yellow Pages

cues.zh: 在按字母排序的列表上干同样的事。
cues.en: doing the same thing with alphabetical listings.

cues.zh: 他们都把店名起成“AAA”“AA”“AAAA”，
cues.en: They would all name their businesses "AAA," "AA," "AAAA,"

cues.zh: 好排到分类的最前面。
cues.en: to get at the front of the category.

cues.zh: 人们总能找到钻系统空子的办法。
cues.en: People have always found a way to game the system.

cues.zh: 问题是现在没人知道这事在发生，
cues.en: Problem is now, no one knows it's happening,

cues.zh: 而且每个城市、每个国家都在发生，
cues.en: and it's happening in every city, in every country,

cues.zh: 每一个服务企业和消费者的分类里都有，
cues.en: every category that services businesses and consumers,

cues.zh: 有超过 50 个大分类，情况已经泛滥成灾。
cues.en: and there are over 50 major categories that this is just epidemically bad.

cues.zh: 最近还暴露出另一个问题——
cues.en: Another problem that's actually come to light recently is -

cues.zh: 你可能熟悉典型的 Google 搜索
cues.en: What you might be familiar with in a typical Google search

cues.zh: 顶部会有 Google AdWords。
cues.en: is at the top, there’s a Google AdWords.

cues.zh: 这些是企业付费购买的广告结果。
cues.en: These are the advertising results that people in businesses have paid for.

cues.zh: 这里看到的，有点模糊，抱歉，
cues.en: And what you see here, and it's a little blurry, my apologies,

cues.zh: 上面写着：“15 美元开锁服务。24 小时，20 分钟响应。”
cues.en: it says, "$15 locksmith service. 24 hours a day, 20 minute response time."

cues.zh: 我不认识任何一个开锁匠
cues.en: I don't know a single locksmith

cues.zh: 在这个国家
cues.en: in this country

cues.zh: 只要 15 美元，它就会开到你身边为你服务
cues.en: that will drive to you and service you for $15

cues.zh: 任何类型的——
cues.en: for any type of -

cues.zh: 15 美元，他们连跟你握个手都不肯。
cues.en: They wouldn't even give you a handshake for $15.

cues.zh: 油钱都不够，人工也不够。
cues.en: It's not worth the gas, it's not worth the labor.

cues.zh: 这是诱饵调包。
cues.en: This is bait and switch.

cues.zh: 这在欺诈教材里非常常见。
cues.en: It's a very common thing in fraud textbooks.

cues.zh: 这个价格他们根本就没打算兑现，
cues.en: It's a price they have absolutely no intention of fulfilling,

cues.zh: 而且他们会狠狠宰你，因为你付不起不付的代价，
cues.en: and they will charge you through the nose because you can't afford not to pay them,

cues.zh: 或者他们已经把服务做完了，然后就靠恐吓。
cues.en: or they've already done the service, and then they use intimidation.

cues.zh: 你被锁在车外了。
cues.en: You're locked out of your car.

cues.zh: 现在是晚上11点。
cues.en: It's 11 o'clock at night.

cues.zh: 你身处一个治安很差的街区。
cues.en: You're in a bad neighborhood.

cues.zh: 他们会出现，是因为你点了一个广告，上面写着“15美元服务”，
cues.en: They show up because you clicked on an ad that said "$15 service,"

cues.zh: 结果现在变成了350，
cues.en: and now it's 350,

cues.zh: 还逼你去ATM取钱。
cues.en: and they make you go to the ATM and pull money out.

cues.zh: 如果这是你奶奶呢？
cues.en: What if it's your grandmother?

cues.zh: 你妻子？你姐妹？
cues.en: Your wife? Your sister?

cues.zh: 这种事确实在发生，媒体也报道过，
cues.en: This happens and it's been in the media,

cues.zh: 但没人跟进，
cues.en: but no one picks it up

cues.zh: 因为这个问题太复杂、太大、涉及多个司法管辖区，
cues.en: because this problem is so complex, and big, and multijurisdictional,

cues.zh: FBI和特勤局都不想碰，
cues.en: the FBI and the Secret Service don't want to touch it,

cues.zh: 还有各州总检察长；
cues.en: the attorneys general;

cues.zh: 牵扯的环节太多了，
cues.en: there are so many different pieces,

cues.zh: 我们必须从问题的根源入手。
cues.en: and we have to start at the original root of the problem.

cues.zh: 这个人经营着一家叫Serbian Crown的店；
cues.en: This man ran a business called the Serbian Crown;

cues.zh: 这是《Wired》杂志上的报道。
cues.en: this is in Wired magazine.

cues.zh: 不喜欢他的黑客
cues.en: Hackers who didn't like him

cues.zh: 把他周末的营业时间改成了零。
cues.en: turned his business hours for the weekend to nothing.

cues.zh: 他们直接删掉了他周末的营业时间，
cues.en: They just deleted his availability on the weekends,

cues.zh: 结果不到一个月，就凭这一手把他的生意搞垮了。
cues.en: and it single-handedly killed his business in less than a month.

cues.zh: 他不得不关门歇业。
cues.en: He had to shut his doors.

cues.zh: 他经营了二十年甚至更久——我觉得还要更长。
cues.en: He was open for two decades or more - I think even longer.

cues.zh: 于是我去找了 Google。
cues.en: So I approached Google.

cues.zh: 我告诉他们这些人用的各种手段——
cues.en: I told them all of the different methods that these guys are using -

cues.zh: 那些漏洞利用，那些钻排名系统空子的方法——
cues.en: the exploits, the ways that they beat the ranking systems -

cues.zh: 而他们什么都没做，这让我挺意外的。
cues.en: and I was pleasantly surprised by them doing absolutely nothing.

cues.zh: 于是我开始编一些搞笑的房源，想借此涨点社交关注，
cues.en: So I started creating some funny listings to maybe get some social following,

cues.zh: 这个是我个人最喜欢的：
cues.en: and this one was my personal favorite:

cues.zh: 白宫草坪上的斯诺登超级秘密藏身处。
cues.en: the Snowden Super Secret Hiding Place on the White House lawn.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 你能看出他们为什么选那张当网站主图了吧。
cues.en: You can see why they chose that for the main website image.

cues.zh: 于是我走进了特勤局的办公室
cues.en: So I walked into the Secret Service office

cues.zh: 在录完那些电话之后。
cues.en: after recording phone calls.

cues.zh: 我身边没带律师。
cues.en: I didn't have a lawyer with me.

cues.zh: 我完全不知道会发生什么，只知道我多少得去那儿
cues.en: I had no idea what was going to happen other than I kind of needed to be there

cues.zh: 因为如果我被抓了，
cues.en: because if I got caught,

cues.zh: 我觉得那可以说就是一趟关塔那摩湾的头等舱度假，
cues.en: I think it arguably would have been a first-class vacation to Guantanamo Bay,

cues.zh: 虽然我曾在海军陆战队服役，
cues.en: and although I was in the Marines,

cues.zh: 但我可不想在那里和他们重聚。
cues.en: I don't want to be reunited with them there.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 而且橙色实在不太适合我。
cues.en: And orange isn't exactly my color.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 我做的很简单。
cues.en: What I did was very simple.

cues.zh: 我创建了一个几乎一模一样的特勤局条目
cues.en: I created a very identical Secret Service listing

cues.zh: 只是换了个电话号码，
cues.en: with a different phone number,

cues.zh: 如你所见，上面这个有三条评论，区号202，
cues.en: and as you can see, this one at the top has three reviews, 202 area code,

cues.zh: 这个区号是425，
cues.en: this one has a 425 area code,

cues.zh: 地址相同，图片更多。
cues.en: same address, more pictures.

cues.zh: 我在不到五分钟内删掉了他们的评论，
cues.en: I deleted their reviews in less than five minutes,

cues.zh: 又添加了自己编造的假评论。
cues.en: and I added reviews of my own that were fake.

cues.zh: 从头到尾不到20分钟。
cues.en: Took less than 20 minutes, beginning to end.

cues.zh: 位置对调了
cues.en: The positions switched

cues.zh: 因为我那个突然多了更多“隐藏得分”，
cues.en: because mine suddenly had more "hidden points,"

cues.zh: 这就意味着，全国任何想找特勤局的人，
cues.en: which then meant anybody who looked for the Secret Service,

cues.zh: 只要是为这个特定目标，
cues.en: anywhere in the country for this specific one,

cues.zh: 就会找到我那个
cues.en: got mine,

cues.zh: 然后那个电话号码就转接到他们那儿，
cues.en: and that phone number forwarded to them,

cues.zh: 而我可以录下通话双方的内容
cues.en: and I could record both sides of the conversation

cues.zh: 完全不用碰他们的系统。
cues.en: without ever touching their systems.

cues.zh: 这严格来说都不算黑客行为。
cues.en: It's not even technically hacking.

cues.zh: 就是
cues.en: It's just

cues.zh: 挺蠢的，真的。
cues.en: stupid, really.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 你好像觉得这是个坏主意。
cues.en: You seem to think it's a bad idea.

cues.zh: 你当时在哪？
cues.en: Where were you?

cues.zh: 这就是我在等的时候。
cues.en: This was me waiting.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 可能再也不用手机了，那不如拍张自拍。
cues.en: Might never use a phone again, so might as well take a selfie.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 当我坐在特勤局办公室的时候，
cues.en: While I was sitting in the Secret Service office,

cues.zh: 等着那些人出现，
cues.en: waiting for the guys to show up,

cues.zh: 他们走出来，全都翻了个白眼。
cues.en: they walked out, they all rolled their eyes.

cues.zh: 他们都觉得我疯了
cues.en: They all thought I was crazy

cues.zh: 因为我刚真的打电话给他们说，
cues.en: because I'd just literally called them and said,

cues.zh: “嗨，我可能刚录了一堆打给你们的电话
cues.en: "Hi, I might have just recorded a bunch of calls to you guys

cues.zh: 想证明点什么。
cues.en: trying to prove something.

cues.zh: 我能进来给你看看吗？
cues.en: Can I come in and show you?"

cues.zh: 哦，当然。当然可以。进来吧。
cues.en: "Oh yeah. Yeah, sure. Yeah, come on in."

cues.zh: 听起来很疯狂。
cues.en: It sounded crazy.

cues.zh: 于是我站在特勤局的办公室里，和探员们在一起
cues.en: So I'm standing there with the agents in the Secret Service office

cues.zh: 就在我拍完那些初始照片之后，
cues.en: right after I took those initial photos,

cues.zh: 那个探员说，
cues.en: and the agent goes,

cues.zh: “听着，我不信你。
cues.en: "Look, I don't believe you.

cues.zh: 这不可能是真的。”
cues.en: This isn't really happening."

cues.zh: 我说：“好。帮我个忙，我现在就证明给你看。
cues.en: I said, "Okay. Do me a favor, and I'll prove this right now.

cues.zh: 打给华盛顿特区的特勤局办公室，
cues.en: Call the Secret Service office in Washington, D.C.,

cues.zh: 我来证明。”
cues.en: and I'll prove it."

cues.zh: 他掏出手机，
cues.en: Pulls his phone out,

cues.zh: 报上自己的名字——
cues.en: says his name -

cues.zh: 他认识电话那头的人。
cues.en: He knew the guy on the other end.

cues.zh: 也许他们是学院里的室友，如果真有这种学院的话。
cues.en: Maybe they were roommates at the academy, if they even go to an academy.

cues.zh: 我也不太清楚。
cues.en: I don't really know.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 谁知道呢，说真的？
cues.en: Who does know, I mean, really?

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 大约五分钟后他们挂了电话，我打开笔记本电脑。
cues.en: They hang up after about five minutes, and I open my laptop.

cues.zh: 我按下播放键，它播放出了我刚才听到的对话，
cues.en: I push play, and it played back the conversation I'd just heard,

cues.zh: 因为他当时就站在我旁边，
cues.en: because he was standing next to me,

cues.zh: 还有我们没听到的那位完整音频。
cues.en: and the full audio of the guy we didn't hear.

cues.zh: 他们的眼睛突然不再转动了。
cues.en: And their eyes suddenly stopped rolling.

cues.zh: 现场变得非常安静。
cues.en: And it got very quiet.

cues.zh: 然后他们递给我一份声明，说：“这是你的米兰达权利。
cues.en: And they handed me a statement saying, "These are your Miranda rights.

cues.zh: 你没有被逮捕，但我们需要搜查你，
cues.en: You are not under arrest but we need to search you,

cues.zh: 我们希望你能跟我们到客房——
cues.en: and we would like you to accompany us to the guest suite -

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 那间豪华的、壁橱大小的套房，没有窗户，
cues.en: this luxurious, closet-sized suite with no windows,

cues.zh: 你将在那里待上一段不确定的时间。
cues.en: in which you'll be staying an undetermined amount of time.

cues.zh: 你没有被逮捕，但我们真的不希望你离开。”
cues.en: You're not under arrest, but we really don't want you to leave."

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 显然，我是自愿去的。
cues.en: Obviously, I was there of my own accord.

cues.zh: 显然，我去那里是因为这是正确的做法，
cues.en: Obviously, I was there because this was the right thing to do,

cues.zh: 因为有更重要的东西处于危险之中，
cues.en: because there was something bigger at stake,

cues.zh: 因为有人在受到影响，
cues.en: because there are people being affected,

cues.zh: 所以我冒了风险。
cues.en: and so I took a risk.

cues.zh: 我冒着再也见不到孩子的风险。
cues.en: I took a risk of never seeing my kids again.

cues.zh: 我冒着被误解的风险。
cues.en: I took a risk of a misunderstanding.

cues.zh: 有人因为比这轻得多的事就被关进监狱，而他们完全是无辜的。
cues.en: There have been people jailed for far less, who are completely innocent.

cues.zh: 我没有任何犯罪意图。
cues.en: I didn't have any criminal intent.

cues.zh: 我立刻走进去说：“哈哈哈，对不起，我是个白痴。
cues.en: I walked in immediately and went like, "Ha ha ha, I'm sorry. I'm an idiot.

cues.zh: 给你。
cues.en: And here you go.

cues.zh: 这是个问题，去修好它。”
cues.en: This is a problem, fix it."

cues.zh: 他们根本没法对我立案说：
cues.en: They couldn't ever bring a case against me saying,

cues.zh: “他打算卖掉这个。”
cues.en: "He was going to sell this."

cues.zh: 我第一个打电话的就是他们！
cues.en: The first people I called was them!

cues.zh: 在房间里的时候，他们打给 Google 说：
cues.en: While in the room, they called Google and said,

cues.zh: “好，他一直在跟你们说，”
cues.en: "Okay, he's been telling you,"

cues.zh: 结果他们说：“哦，但我们没信他，”
cues.en: and they go, "Oh, but we didn't believe him,"

cues.zh: 然后……
cues.en: and then ...

cues.zh: 我不知道他们到底说了什么，我没在监听那通电话。
